source_snapshot.items: Reset form after OEM Firmware update completes
source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC Web Operations > OEM Firmware, perform a firmware Flash, verify success popup, then inspect form state.
source_snapshot.criteria: After successful update, selected device and file entries are cleared.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves the real WebUI Flash and reset check but lacks immutable target/image, backend terminal-state and recovery controls.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires one approved Flash, independent version/health evidence and exact post-success form controls.

old_problem: A popup or page reload could clear fields independently of real firmware success. Exact OEM target/image, backend task boundary, form-reset timing, activation and recovery were unspecified, but can be bound safely at runtime.
disposition_reason: ED-07/08 require the actual approved Flash and pre/post version evidence, while ED-06/15/20 allow target/image/UI/task details as project configuration. The review preserves the success popup and both cleared controls but makes them valid only after correlated terminal task and independent firmware health; no UI-only substitute or retry is allowed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2235, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2236 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00018-V001 / df1ca45ef63bd507 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind the exact BMC/SUT, OEM component instance/model/serial/current version and signed compatible target image/version/hash/signature.
Capture initial empty, selected device and selected file control states without exposing credentials or local paths.
After separate one-shot authorization, submit exactly one update and correlate browser state with the backend job ID/progress/terminal result; do not refresh, navigate away or interrupt.
Verify the success popup, active/staged firmware version and target/BMC/SUT health independently.

At the approved completion boundary, prove both device and file controls are empty and no residual file metadata remains; reload/session reset cannot substitute unless the product contract explicitly sets that boundary.
Stop on wrong target/image, validation error, lost session, timeout/indeterminate task or health fault; never retry automatically.
No login, WebUI action, firmware Flash, activation/restart, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: OEM WebUI firmware Flash success and device/file form reset
test_case.purpose: Verify that one approved OEM firmware update genuinely succeeds and that, at the documented completion boundary, the WebUI clears both selected device and file fields so stale selections cannot be reused.
required_package: Exact BMC/SUT/WebUI and OEM target component identity/current version
Signed compatible image, target version/hash/signature and update intent
WebUI control selectors, popup, backend task and reset-timing contract
Stable power/network, maintenance/activation/final-state and rollback/reflash recovery
test_case.test_command: After one-shot authorization, record initial and selected form states, submit the immutable approved target/image once, preserve browser/backend job progression to terminal success without refresh/interruption, verify popup plus active/staged version and health, then assert in the documented same-session/reconnect state that both device and file controls and residual metadata are cleared.
test_case.expected_result: The correct target completes one terminal-success update, reports the intended active/staged version and healthy state, displays the approved success popup, and clears both target-device and file entries exactly at the specified completion boundary.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correlated immutable target/image, terminal backend success, popup, independent version/health proof and both cleared controls. Popup-only, form clear after arbitrary reload/session reset, one uncleared control, staged-only mismatch, indeterminate task or failed recovery is not PASS. Missing bindings blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target/image/signature/compatibility, stable power/network, activation and recovery are signed.
Separate one-shot Flash authorization; no refresh, interruption, parallel job or automatic retry.
Protect credentials/local paths in UI artifacts.
Stop on identity mismatch, lost access, validation error, timeout/partial task or hardware fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and BMC/SUT/OEM target identity/current version
Timestamped initial/selected/post-success DOM values and screenshots for device/file controls
Redacted request/job ID, progress, terminal result and success popup
Active/staged version, target/BMC/SUT health, no-interruption/no-retry audit and final state
test_case.recovery: On failed or indeterminate task, do not retry, refresh to hide state or start another job. Preserve browser/backend evidence and use the signed rollback/reflash/vendor recovery path; verify component/BMC/SUT health before any new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently requires real successful Flash followed by clearing both form fields; missing product details are project inputs.

blocked.reason: The Flash-dependent UI transition is clear; target/image/task/reset/recovery bindings are supplyable.
